comfyui.ltx_guider: LTXVDualCFGGuider is provided by comfy_extras/nodes_lt.py at the pinned core revision.

cuda.torchaudio: The pinned core requirements and active graph nodes do not depend on torchaudio. The reference environment also contained torchaudio 2.11.0+cu130. The official index had no matching 2.14.1 Windows CPython 3.12 cu130 wheel at verification time.

verification.core: Clean tracked reference checkout; commit also resolves upstream.
verification.runtime: All 94 selected artifacts have Windows CPython 3.12 compatible wheels with published SHA-256. Each exact wheel's PEP 658 metadata was fetched from its publisher. Every applicable default Requires-Dist entry resolved within the lock under Windows markers. pip parsed 88 hashed base requirements; the other six wheels are in the approval catalog. No clean-machine installation was performed.
verification.models: All 12 distinct active safetensors have verified local SHA-256 and sizes matching pinned upstream records. Kokoro model sha256 was verified against the installed release file; upstream GitHub release metadata publishes its byte count but no digest.
verification.model_access: Stable Audio Open 1.0 and LTX-2.5 require acceptance of their respective Hugging Face model terms and an authenticated download.
